titleEn: Number of Laser Beams in a Bank
title: 银行中的激光束数量
summary: 每行安全设备数非零的相邻有效行之间形成两两激光束，求总束数。
insight: 忽略没有设备的行；当前非空行设备数与上一非空行设备数的乘积就是两行之间的激光束数。
pitfalls: 空行不切断相邻有效行关系
乘积在逐行扫描时累加

solutions.title: 非空行乘积扫描
solutions.idea: 只保留上一非空行的设备数。
steps: 统计每行字符一的数量 current

code.java: class Solution { public int numberOfBeams(String[] bank){int previous=0,answer=0;for(String row:bank){int current=0;for(int i=0;i<row.length();i++)if(row.charAt(i)=='1')current++;if(current>0){answer+=previous*current;previous=current;}}return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun numberOfBeams(bank:Array<String>):Int{var previous=0;var answer=0;for(row in bank){val current=row.count{it=='1'};if(current>0){answer+=previous*current;previous=current}};return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public:int numberOfBeams(vector<string>& bank){int previous=0,answer=0;for(string& row:bank){int current=count(row.begin(),row.end(),'1');if(current){answer+=previous*current;previous=current;}}return answer;} };
